script.text: Back in 2015, OpenAI was born — a dream to make AI safe for everyone.
script.prompt: A dimly lit office space filled with whiteboards covered in equations and diagrams. Soft blue glow from computer screens casts shadows across focused faces. The camera slowly zooms in on a handwritten mission statement pinned to a corkboard: "Make AI safe." Outside the window, dusk settles over Silicon Valley, streetlights flickering to life as the last golden sunlight fades behind distant hills.
script.voice: Back in 2015, OpenAI was born — a dream to make AI safe for everyone.

script.text: Elon Musk and Sam Altman teamed up, promising to keep AI open and free.
script.prompt: A sleek, futuristic conference hall bathed in cool blue light. Elon Musk and Sam Altman stand side by side on a minimalist stage, their faces illuminated by holographic projections displaying AI code and neural networks. Behind them, translucent screens flicker with real-time data streams and global connectivity maps. The camera tracks slowly around them as they shake hands, shadows stretching dramatically across the polished floor. Outside the floor-to-ceiling windows, city lights pulse in sync with the energy of the moment, while glowing digital banners announce "OPEN AI FUTURE" in bold, shifting typography.
script.voice: Elon Musk and Sam Altman teamed up, promising to keep AI open and free.

script.text: But soon, the mission split — safety versus competition.
script.prompt: Two climbers stand on a narrow ice ridge, their silhouettes stark against the stormy twilight sky. One adjusts their harness, glancing back toward the base camp barely visible through swirling snow. The other stares upward at the treacherous summit, their ice axe glinting faintly in the fading light. Their ropes diverge—one taut toward descent, the other straining toward the peak—as snowflakes streak horizontally across the frame.
script.voice: But soon, the mission split — safety versus competition.

script.text: Musk left, warning that AI could become "more dangerous than nukes."
script.prompt: A dimly lit conference room with sleek modern furnishings. Elon Musk stands silhouetted against floor-to-ceiling windows showing a futuristic cityscape at twilight. His face is half-lit by the glow of holographic projections displaying neural networks. As he turns to leave, his shadow stretches dramatically across the glass, distorted by scrolling lines of code reflected in the panes. Outside, towering server farms pulse with ominous blue light, their cooling towers emitting faint tendrils of vapor into the night sky. The camera lingers on an abandoned robotic arm twitching sporadically in the corner as Musk exits through sliding doors that hiss shut behind him.
script.voice: Musk left, warning that AI could become "more dangerous than nukes."

script.text: And from that moment, the race for the future truly began.
script.prompt: A neon-lit cityscape pulses with energy, towering skyscrapers stretching into a twilight sky filled with holographic advertisements. Below, sleek autonomous vehicles weave through glowing streets at blistering speeds, their headlights painting streaks of light in the dusk. A distant rocket ignites its engines, lifting off from a launchpad amidst swirling clouds of vapor, its fiery trail cutting upwards toward the stars. The camera sweeps across the scene—drones dart between buildings, scientists in high-tech labs manipulate floating holograms, and engineers assemble gleaming prototypes under the hum of robotic arms. The future accelerates into motion, unstoppable and electrifying.
script.voice: And from that moment, the race for the future truly began.
